name: Burning Hands
description:
Uncheck a Condition. If you did, roll Spirit vs Dexterity against a creature within short range. On a win, it takes 2d6 damage. On a loss, half damage.

If the Condition you unchecked was Anger, +1d damage.

Describe how your hands erupt in flame.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: You may target one additional creature within short range.
